energy_model.note: Compute energy leg by leg — payload decreases at each drop.

no_fly_zones.note: Depot→customer edges guaranteed clear. Customer-customer edges may be blocked.

changes_from_v2: NFZ reduced from 45 → 10 (largest/most meaningful zones, excluding depot-intersecting ones)
AABB check kept — simpler and consistent with reduced NFZ set
Customer generation uses rejection sampling: depot→customer edge always clear
